content: I've made a PR #38343 suggesting moving Nat.mul_le_pow and Nat.two_mul_sq_add_one_le_two_pow_two_mul to Data/Nat/Basic (they are not related to Nat.cast). However, I feel that Nat.mul_le_pow could be moved to Init.Data.Nat.Lemmas, where Nat.lt_pow_self lives, since Nat.mul_le_pow follows immediately from Nat.lt_pow_self. Is there a way to contribute to Init? I suppose not? Thank you.

Gian Cordana Sanjaya said:

Is there a way to contribute to Init?

https://github.com/leanprover/lean4/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md
But it's not so easy
I'll take that as "let's hope someone else does it". Thanks.
